arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'

SELECT 'config' AS kind,service AS id,value AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking',booking_id,json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'ref',client_reference,'confirmed_at',confirmed_at) FROM bookings
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges
UNION ALL SELECT 'event',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'fare_hold' AS kind,hold_id AS id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) AS data FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM (SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12)

SELECT 'pending' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'ref',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step,'cancel',ce.event_id) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON b.request_id=ce.request_id WHERE b.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',service,value FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds
UNION ALL SELECT 'refund',refund_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents) FROM refunds
